svg.title: What occupies the circled spaces on the 100T FPGA board
svg.desc: Three measured component diagrams at equal scale: current core front, separate mezzanine connector-fit front, and mirrored core back. Front spaces correspond to two connector positions. The back right strip is behind three regulators. Lower back space may accept bulk capacitors after review. No smaller board is validated.

g.text: Where the circled space can help
Equal-scale native CAD geometry · 100T / CSG324 · current outline remains 40 × 36 mm
The existing J5/J6 fit is shown as an overlay.
Lower edge: repack the red-boxed U3 group.
Their placement must be planned together
with the mating routing board and all routes.
Repacking requires new routing and checks.
Space to repack exists. A smaller complete-board outline has not yet been demonstrated.
Component/body outlines and vias only; signal copper and planes omitted. Highlights are review areas, not cleared routing space.
Source: frozen core 3844c24f… and separate mezzanine fit 186018ad… · geometry review, 26 September 2026
